I want to know why people say we should not read salaam after prayers? 8422 views Q. I am a resident of Ottawa, Canada. During Summer season in the month of May, June, July and August we have to pray Isha Salaat very late in the night. For example, Isha Salaat on June 1st starts at 10:39 and in the middle of the month it goes up to 10:54. This causes undue hardship to people. And we foresee, it will cause lots of hardship during Ramadan when people will pray 20 Rakah Tarawih. We know that in Hanafi Fiqh there is provision to start Isha Salaat at the Shafaq Ahmar time. We seek your Fatwa and opinion on praying Salaat earlier at locations that have Isha times very late in the night. 3343 views
answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 21134 Country: United Kingdom Title: i know a person who started masturbating at the age of 13 but did nor have a wetdream till age of 14. does he have to pray namaaz since age of 13 or 14? Question: i know a person who started masturbating at the age of 13 but did nor have a wetdream till age of 14. does he have to pray namaaz since age of 13 or 14? Answer ID: 21134 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 605/405/L=1431) He will have to offer salah from the time when he starts experiencing wet dream, provided semen is not discharged due to the masturbation, otherwise from that time onward he will have to make qaza of missed salah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
